newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to contribute $81 million to ICRC.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to contribute $81 million to ICRC.

text.p: The United States announced on Friday that it would contribute $81 million towards the 1997 budget of the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC).

Assistant Secretary of State for Population, Refugees and Migration Phyllis Oakley announced the figure at a meeting with Cornelio Sommaruga, president of the Geneva-based ICRC, the State Department said.
U.S. officials said the figure compared with $89 million last year, but that due to currency fluctuations the contribution was roughly the same in terms of the Swiss franc.

The United States is the largest contributor to the ICRC and normally covers about 20 per cent of its annual budget. It also makes ad hoc contributions in response to appeals for specific emergencies, the officials said.
The ICRC provides aid and protection to conflict victims around the world.
